scope: Fixed finite value Gram/Jacobian/Taylor and linear margin; CPU float64 public development fixtures and premise checks only.

implementation.procedure: Review card and actual script, matrix shapes, normalization and fixed V/W.

reference_boundary.procedure: Independent rational/Decimal and finite-difference reference, n=1 and nullspace, hardmask refusal.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Exact identities 1e-10 scaled tolerance; derivative finite differences 1e-6 scaled; Taylor bound plus 1e-10 slack.

data_integrity.procedure: Read frozen input/config/raw and reproduce all case IDs and counts.
data_integrity.acceptance: No missing/duplicate cases or fabricated heldout results.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Inspect finite outputs, PSD quadratic forms, units, sharp examples and geometric zeros.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: No nonfinite; no negative squared error beyond 1e-10.

measurement_validity.procedure: No production speed or model quality claim; duration is diagnostic only.
measurement_validity.acceptance: N/A for GPU/LLM performance; token encoding scope explicitly limited.

reproducibility.procedure: Run frozen command to separate destination and compare deterministic cases.
reproducibility.acceptance: Cases agree within declared tolerances; limitations reported.
